section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title: INSPECTION AND REPLACEMENT OF DIFFERENTIAL

content.description: Two bearing outer races labeled L.H. (left hand) and R.H. (right hand)

content.text: (d) Remove the differential case bearing outer race from the carrier.
Tag the bearing outer races to show the location for reassembly.
14. REMOVE DRIVE PINION FROM DIFFERENTIAL CARRIER
(a) Using SST and a press, pull out the rear bearing from the drive pinion.

content.description: Drive pinion with SST tool being used to remove rear bearing

content.text: If the drive pinion or ring gear are damaged, replace them as a set.
(b) Install the washer on the drive pinion with the chamfered end facing the pinion gear.
(c) Using SST and a press, press the reused washer and rear bearing onto the drive pinion.

content.description: Drive pinion with SST tool being used to install washer and bearing

content.text: 2. REPLACE DRIVE PINION FRONT AND REAR BEARING OUTER RACE
(a) Using a hammer and brass bar, drive out the outer race.
(b) Using SST, drive in a new outer race.

content.description: Two illustrations showing the process of driving out old outer race and driving in new outer race using SST

content.text: 3. REMOVE SIDE BEARINGS FROM DIFFERENTIAL CASE
Using SST, pull the side bearing from the differential case.

content.description: Illustration showing SST being used to pull side bearing from differential case, with detail circle showing bearing removal
